overview: Built an automated workshop management system for handling customer inquiries, vehicle appointments, inspections, repair estimates, parts coordination, technician assignments, repair tracking, and customer retention.

The workflow takes a new customer inquiry and turns it into a complete repair lifecycle, from booking and vehicle check-in to estimate approval, repair completion, pickup notification, service reminders, and review follow-ups.

list: Receives customer inquiries through WhatsApp or website forms
Searches existing customer and vehicle records automatically
Retrieves previous vehicle service and repair history
Creates new service requests and repair orders
Checks workshop availability and sends appointment options
Creates confirmed appointments in Google Calendar
Sends automatic appointment reminders to customers
Records vehicle check-in details, mileage, condition, and photos
Creates dedicated Google Drive folders for each repair order
Searches and assigns technicians based on skill, availability, and workload
Processes technician inspection reports using AI
Creates structured customer-friendly inspection summaries
Calculates repair estimates including parts and labor
Sends digital estimates for customer approval
Follows up automatically when an estimate remains unanswered
Generates required parts lists from approved repair work
Checks workshop parts inventory before purchasing
Searches and compares local parts suppliers when stock is unavailable
Creates and sends supplier parts orders automatically
Tracks delayed, partial, damaged, or incorrect parts deliveries
Sends proactive repair-delay updates to customers
Tracks repair progress and technician completion
Routes completed repairs through quality control
Generates final service summaries and repair reports
Updates complete vehicle service history automatically
Sends ready-for-pickup notifications through WhatsApp
Sends future maintenance reminders and customer review requests
Detects dormant customers for re-engagement campaigns
Updates workshop performance analytics in Google Sheets

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined workshop communication, estimate, service report, and reminder templates.

list: Appointment communication
Repair estimate format
Parts and supplier requests
Customer repair updates
Service reminders

blocks.p: This keeps workshop communication consistent across customers, vehicles, technicians, and repair orders.
Airtable or SmartSuite acts as the central customer, vehicle, repair order, technician, and parts tracking system.
Each repair order is updated with:

list: Customer information
Vehicle details
Technician assignment
Estimate status
Parts status
Repair status
Pickup status
Final cost
Next service date

result: A complete automated auto repair workflow that turns a customer inquiry into an appointed, inspected, approved, repaired, documented, and completed vehicle service without requiring workshop staff to manually coordinate every step.
The system also keeps customer records, vehicle history, repair estimates, parts orders, technician activity, service reminders, reviews, and workshop analytics organized in one workflow.
